name: Week Plan
job: Lay out a plan week by week: what will be true by the end of each week, how it cascades from executive to surgical, where the kairos forks sit and what must be true at each, and how best, base and worst play out, with keep and kill switches, on-ramps, off-ramps, opportunity cost and stop-losses on one color-coded sparkline.

anatomy.role: Each week's tab carries three branch ends and the stop-loss; a week not drafted is one flat dashed line; steel until an ROI value is set

Best, base, worst as lanes D1 to D7: orange until the stop-loss (opportunity cost), a gold stop mark, then steel until an ROI value is set, green or red by its sign after; kairos forks as gold dashed lines; on-ramps cyan, off-ramps steel
Per branch: path, ROI, opportunity cost, stop-loss and what it keeps, pre-mortem with falsifiers
Executive to surgical in one container with hairline dividers, on the `--wp-key` keyline; the altitude dot and label carry the color (observatory L5 to L1); forks tagged on their altitude
Sparkline with keep and kill paths, a keep/kill switch that starts undecided (data `decision` sets it), keep-if, kill-if, on-ramp, off-ramp, if true, if false, premises with falsifiers
Verb (analyze to recapitulate, written out) by lens (D W H C R, keyed underneath); lit cells carry the count; the method list tags verb, lens and altitude
First to fifth order, nested, in a 56 Fold

Every hypothesis carries a dot grain at `--wp-fog` (default 0.5), the strip and tab sparklines included when their branches are hypotheses; text stays at full strength. Quoted-from-the-page items get a cyan chip, never green: green is kept for what happened

states.note: Lane notes, cascade and matrix stack; tabs sit four to a row; the strip keeps its scale and scrolls sideways.

use_when: A plan has to show, week by week, what must be true for it to work and how it fails gracefully.
The reader decides keep or kill at named forks, so the forks, ramps and stop-losses need to be visible before the work starts.
avoid_when: Do not use it for a dated list of deliverables with no forks; that is 46 Day List or 13 90-Day Build.
Do not use it to show measured results; that is 07 Probability Bar or 04 Signal Delta Table. This organism draws shape until values are set.

data.note: The end state, written as done.
A week with `draft: true` renders as not drafted.

data.type: {id, day, fork, premises[], keep_if, kill_if, onramp, offramp}

data.note: Each with roi, opportunity_cost, stop_loss, p and p_basis; p stays null until set.
Lens keys match the hypercube explorer.
Depth equals order, first to fifth.
On every leaf; `sourced` needs a `source`. Schema: `runtime/specs/week-plan.schema.json`.

access: Weeks are a real tablist: arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs; without JavaScript every week shows, stacked.
Each sparkline has a text title or label; every line it draws is also written out in the lane notes and fork cards, so nothing is carried by color alone.
The keep/kill switch is two buttons with `aria-pressed`; a polite live region says what changed and names the off-ramp.
Fog grain never lowers text contrast; print drops the grain and opens every fold and week.

used_by.name: Gravity candidate page (gravity.arcs.care), proposed in place of the Week One block

gates: `week_plan_build.py --check` (in scripts): the demo and the example page match the data.
`week_plan_build.py --self-test`: schema rules, seven tabs, shape-only note, no em-dashes.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000, both themes.

Kairos forks

K1 \u00b7 Day 1 \u00b7 Tactical

Does the pass list reach me on day 1?

Keep if
The list arrives with a reason on most rows.
Kill if
No list by day 3: stop waiting and rebuild it from one conversation.
On-ramp, day 1
Ask for the list in the first meeting, framed as onboarding, not audit.
Off-ramp, day 3
Switch to the rebuilt list; the memo keeps its day 5 date.
If true
Reopen signals go on every pass by day 2.
If false
Rebuild the list from one conversation; day 1 work slides to day 3 and the memo keeps its day.
What must be true (2)
  • Gravity keeps a pass list I can read on day 1. Falsifier: No list exists, or it lives only in people's heads.
  • Each pass was written with a reason, not only a no. Falsifier: Most rows carry no reason, so there is nothing to attach a reopen signal to.

K2 \u00b7 Day 5 \u00b7 Surgical

Does the agent-payments wedge survive its own memo?

Keep if
The three gaps are still open and someone reads the memo.
Kill if
A network publishes agent dispute rights, or the memo cannot name one buyer.
On-ramp, day 2
Write the kill criteria on day 2, before drafting.
Off-ramp, day 5
Kill it in writing; the reasons become the first pass-record entry.
If true
The memo goes forward as the first one-pager in the EIR tab's 30-day plan.
If false
The kill is written down with its reason, and it becomes the first entry in the pass record.
What must be true (2)
  • The three gaps (no chargeback, freeze on legal process, no record of what the agent expected) are still open on day 5. Falsifier: A card network or issuer publishes agent dispute rights before day 5.
  • Someone at Gravity reads a one-pager in week one. Falsifier: No reply or comment on the memo by the end of the week.
